points.title: 出身与早年
points.description: 萨拉丁出生于伊拉克北部的提克里特，他的父亲纳吉姆丁·艾尤布是库尔德人，服务于赞吉王朝。萨拉丁的童年和青少年时期主要在巴尔贝克和大马士革度过，接受了良好的教育和军事训练。这段时期，他学习了伊斯兰教义、军事战略和行政管理知识，为他后来的军事和政治生涯奠定了基础。萨拉丁的叔叔阿萨德·丁· Shirkuh是赞吉王朝的重要将领，对萨拉丁的成长产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: Saladin was born in Tikrit, Iraq, to Kurdish parents. His father Najm al-Din Ayyub served the Zengid dynasty. During his childhood and youth, Saladin lived in Baalbek and Damascus, receiving a comprehensive education in Islamic theology, military strategy, and administration. This period of learning and training under his uncle Asad al-Din Shirkuh, a prominent Zengid general, shaped his future military and political career, providing him with the knowledge and skills that would later prove crucial in his rise to power.

points.title: 崛起与掌权
points.description: 1163年，萨拉丁随叔叔Shirkuh前往埃及，支持法蒂玛王朝对抗十字军。他表现出卓越的军事才能，在多次战役中击败十字军。1169年，Shirkuh去世后，萨拉丁被任命为埃及维齐尔（宰相）。1171年，他废黜了末代法蒂玛哈里发，结束了法蒂玛王朝的统治，建立了阿尤布王朝，成为埃及苏丹。这一时期，萨拉丁不仅巩固了在埃及的统治，还开始整合军事力量，为日后对抗十字军做准备。
points.descriptionEn: In 1163, Saladin accompanied his uncle Shirkuh to Egypt to support the Fatimid dynasty against the Crusaders. He demonstrated exceptional military talent in several campaigns against the Crusaders. After Shirkuh's death in 1169, Saladin was appointed as the vizier of Egypt. In 1171, he overthrew the last Fatimid caliph, ending the Fatimid dynasty and establishing the Ayyubid Sultanate, becoming the Sultan of Egypt. During this period, Saladin not only consolidated his rule in Egypt but also began to unify military forces, preparing for future confrontations with the Crusaders.

points.title: 统一穆斯林世界
points.description: 1174年，努尔丁去世后，萨拉丁开始扩张领土，先后征服叙利亚、美索不达米亚和也门等地。他将大马士革作为首都，建立了统一的穆斯林政权。萨拉丁推行宗教宽容政策，尊重基督教和犹太教徒的信仰自由，同时加强伊斯兰教育，修建清真寺和学校。他还改革军队，建立了一支强大的常备军，为即将到来的十字军东征做准备。这一时期，萨拉丁成功地将分散的穆斯林力量整合为一个强大的帝国，为对抗十字军奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: After Nur al-Din's death in 1174, Saladin began expanding his territories, conquering Syria, Mesopotamia, and Yemen. He established Damascus as his capital and created a unified Muslim state. Saladin implemented policies of religious tolerance, respecting the freedom of Christian and Jewish faiths, while strengthening Islamic education by building mosques and schools. He reformed the military, creating a powerful standing army in preparation for the upcoming Crusades. During this period, Saladin successfully consolidated fragmented Muslim forces into a powerful empire, laying the foundation for the confrontation with the Crusaders.

points.title: 哈丁战役与收复圣地
points.titleEn: Battle of Hattin and Recapture of Jerusalem
points.description: 1187年7月4日，萨拉丁在哈丁战役中击败十字军，俘虏了耶路撒冷国王居伊·吕西尼安。随后，他于10月2日收复了被十字军占领88年的耶路撒冷。这一胜利震惊了欧洲，引发了第三次十字军东征。萨拉丁在收复耶路撒冷后，表现出了罕见的宽容，允许城内基督徒安全离开，甚至为贫困者提供旅费。这一举动与十字军当年攻占耶路撒冷时的残暴形成鲜明对比，使萨拉丁在欧洲赢得了'高贵敌人'的声誉。
points.descriptionEn: On July 4, 1187, Saladin defeated the Crusaders at the Battle of Hattin, capturing King Guy of Lusignan. Subsequently, on October 2, he recaptured Jerusalem, which had been under Crusader control for 88 years. This victory shocked Europe and triggered the Third Crusade. After recapturing Jerusalem, Saladin demonstrated remarkable tolerance by allowing the city's Christian inhabitants to leave safely, even providing funds for the poor. This contrasted sharply with the brutality of the Crusaders' capture of Jerusalem, earning Saladin the reputation of a 'noble enemy' in Europe.

points.title: 晚年与遗产
points.description: 1192年，萨拉丁与理查一世达成协议，结束了第三次十字军东征，保留了耶路撒冷在穆斯林手中，但允许基督徒朝圣。回到大马士革后，萨拉丁专注于巩固帝国和建设公共工程。他修建医院、学校和水道，促进了文化和科学发展。1193年3月4日，萨拉丁在大马士革因发热去世，享年55岁。他去世时，国库几乎空虚，因为他将财富主要用于慈善事业和公共建设。萨拉丁被安葬在大马士革倭马亚清真寺旁，他的统治和遗产成为穆斯林世界抵抗十字军的象征，也是骑士精神和宽容的典范。
points.descriptionEn: In 1192, Saladin reached an agreement with Richard I, ending the Third Crusade while keeping Jerusalem under Muslim control but allowing Christian pilgrims access. Returning to Damascus, Saladin focused on consolidating his empire and constructing public works. He built hospitals, schools, and aqueducts, promoting cultural and scientific development. On March 4, 1193, Saladin died of fever in Damascus at the age of 55. At his death, the treasury was nearly empty, as he had used his wealth primarily for charitable works and public construction. Saladin was buried near the Umayyad Mosque in Damascus. His rule and legacy became a symbol of Muslim resistance against the Crusades, as well as an example of chivalry and tolerance.

supporter.zh: 萨拉丁被穆斯林世界视为英雄和解放者，他成功统一了分裂的穆斯林势力，收复了耶路撒冷，结束了十字军对圣地的占领。他的宽容和仁慈赢得了广泛尊重，即使在敌人眼中也是如此。萨拉丁建立的阿尤布王朝促进了伊斯兰学术和文化的发展，他的统治被视为黄金时代。他被视为骑士精神的典范，将军事才能与道德品质完美结合，成为伊斯兰世界抵抗外敌的象征。
supporter.en: Saladin is revered in the Muslim world as a hero and liberator who successfully unified fragmented Muslim forces, recaptured Jerusalem, and ended Crusader occupation of the Holy Land. His tolerance and mercy earned widespread respect, even among his enemies. The Ayyubid dynasty he fostered promoted Islamic scholarship and culture, with his rule considered a golden age. He is seen as an embodiment of chivalry, perfectly combining military prowess with moral virtues, becoming a symbol of Islamic resistance against foreign invaders.

critic.zh: 批评者指出萨拉丁的统治并非完全宽容，他对某些异教徒群体实施歧视政策，特别是在征服后对一些地区的处理上。他的军事扩张虽然统一了穆斯林世界，但也导致了大量人员伤亡。此外，萨拉丁在政治上有时表现出实用主义而非原则性，例如与某些基督教势力的临时联盟。一些历史学家认为，萨拉丁的形象被后世过度美化，他的统治也存在权力集中和独断专行的特点。
critic.en: Critics point out that Saladin's rule was not entirely tolerant, as he implemented discriminatory policies against certain religious groups, particularly in his treatment of conquered regions. His military campaigns, while unifying the Muslim world, resulted in significant casualties. Additionally, Saladin sometimes demonstrated pragmatism over principle in his political dealings, such as temporary alliances with certain Christian forces. Some historians argue that Saladin's image has been overly romanticized by later generations, and his rule was characterized by centralized power and autocratic tendencies.

objective.zh: 从历史角度看，萨拉丁是中世纪最重要的穆斯林领袖之一，他的统治改变了中东的政治格局。在流行文化中，他常被描绘为与理查一世对决的骑士英雄，象征着东西方文明的交锋与对话。历史学界普遍认可萨拉丁的军事才能和政治智慧，同时也承认他的统治带有时代局限性。他既是抵抗十字军的民族英雄，也是促进不同文明间理解的桥梁。萨拉丁的遗产超越了宗教和政治界限，成为人类历史上宽容与骑士精神的永恒象征。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Saladin was one of the most significant Muslim leaders of the Middle Ages, whose rule transformed the political landscape of the Middle East. In popular culture, he is often depicted as a heroic knight in confrontation with Richard I, symbolizing the clash and dialogue between Eastern and Western civilizations. Historians generally acknowledge Saladin's military genius and political wisdom while recognizing the limitations of his rule within his historical context. He is both a national hero who resisted the Crusaders and a bridge promoting understanding between different civilizations. Saladin's legacy transcends religious and political boundaries, becoming an eternal symbol of tolerance and chivalry in human history.

self.zh: 真正的胜利不是征服敌人，而是赢得他们的尊重。
self.en: The true victory is not in conquering the enemy, but in winning their respect.

others.zh: 萨拉丁是一位伟大的君主，他既勇敢又慷慨，既虔诚又公正，他值得我们所有人的赞美。
others.en: Saladin was a great prince, valiant and generous, pious and just, worthy of all praise.
